generation.scope: On every invariant smooth nondegenerate curve component the opposite two-point contraction has a finite flat rank-drop divisor of bidegree (2,2), with class the diagonal plus the inverse four-step graph twisted by the inverse polarization second difference on both factors. Small fixed loci force zero second difference in genus at least two; the bielliptic exceptional divisor and all elliptic translation cases are explicit. Elliptic quartic second differences are six-torsion. On every smooth septic the canonical four-step map is the bielliptic deck involution and the divisor is the nonzero two-torsion displacement on its elliptic quotient.
